description: OBJECT_AGG(key, value) aggregates key/value pairs into a single OBJECT. Pairs with a NULL key or a NULL value are omitted, scalar value TYPES survive so a boolean stays true rather than the string "true", and the result is canonical JSON with keys sorted. Covers the loader round trip - FLATTEN an OBJECT into key/value rows then OBJECT_AGG them back, where the boolean and number values must not return quoted - and the two-argument aggregate working as a WINDOW function over a partition, which the single-argument feed used to answer as an empty object. Converted 1:1 from functions/ObjectAggTest (now retired); its @BeforeEach kv fixture is inlined per test.

INSERT INTO kv SELECT 1, 'alpha', TO_VARIANT('s')
INSERT INTO kv SELECT 1, NULL, TO_VARIANT('dropped')
INSERT INTO kv SELECT 1, 'nul', NULL
SELECT OBJECT_AGG(k, v) FROM kv WHERE grp = 1
CREATE TABLE kv (grp INTEGER, k VARCHAR, v VARIANT)
INSERT INTO kv SELECT 2, 'only', TO_VARIANT(TRUE)
SELECT OBJECT_AGG(k, v) FROM kv WHERE grp = 2

SELECT OBJECT_AGG(f.key::VARCHAR, f.value)
FROM (SELECT 1 AS i), LATERAL FLATTEN(input => OBJECT_CONSTRUCT('b', TRUE, 'n', 5, 's', 'x')) f
CREATE TABLE kv (grp INTEGER, k VARCHAR, v VARIANT)
